note: Fight it out (brief 018 §5), the loud twin of loud: the police never break, so once the response unit is down the Scout and Tech close on the officers at the café wall and the cell downs them all; then the three board after the Enforcer (the seal clock runs: anyone left standing would be captured). Nobody is up to see the car go. The loud front (GDD §07 loud; Keel N10): loop the camera and reroute the patrol, shoot the guard just after his 2:30 check-in mark, enter (68 s at Alert 2), take Vale out and fight the police at the getaway car with the whole armed cell. No contact. The Tech and the Enforcer run (free once the run is loud; before it, noticed). Once the guard is shot the Scout, Fixer and Tech run to cover by the car and draw; the Enforcer brings Vale to the car under their cover. Re-sited 2026-10-19 (Waymark, brief 023; Sky's door option (b)): the response unit now walks from the north street along Rocket Lane past the getaway car to the public door on the west face, so the Scout and Fixer keep their weapons holstered in cover until the final fight (drawn, they were seen by the passing officers and the fight began at the car before the Enforcer was out); they draw and fire at will when it opens, as the Tech does. The close on the café wall once the response unit was down is gone: from the cover by the car the cell downs both officers, and walking out at them got the Scout and the Tech downed.
